cardOverview.overviewText: A luxury lifestyle card positioned as an aspirational product, offering travel privileges, milestone-based vouchers, and high rewards on shopping and dining.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: The card provides an air accidental cover worth 15 lakhs and a non-air accidental death cover worth 5 lakhs.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to Bank of Baroda Customer Care at 1800 22 5100 and for email support, contact crm@bobfinancial.com
